name: Modern bungalow (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Single-storey bungalow, 15 x 10 m: brick-slip walls on a concrete plinth, a low hipped roof of grey concrete tiles, aluminium windows with precast sills, a front porch with a concrete deck, steps and a flat steel canopy on posts. Enterable: two bedrooms, a bathroom, a living room and a kitchen in a row joined by doorways along the rear.
